subject: adding aggregate column to long format data frame

messages.author: 505f87eeb7607479
messages.subject: adding aggregate column to long format data frame
parts:
Hi,
Assuming I melted the data frame df:
> df
grp subgrp value
1 A a 3
2 A b 4
3 B a 1
4 B c 2
5 B b 5

How can I put back into df the group sums:
> cast(df,grp~.,sum)
grp (all)
1 A 7
2 B 8

So in the end I get something like this:
grp subgrp value grp_sum
1 A a 3 7
2 A b 4 7
3 B a 1 8
4 B c 2 8
5 B b 5 8

I'm aware of merge_recurse(list(df, cast(df, grp ~ ., sum)) but my
real df is way too big and I get memory allocation issues.

Thanks,

Nacho

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: adding aggregate column to long format data frame
parts:
Hi Nacho,

Either use ddply + transform:

ddply(df, "grp", transform, grp_sum = sum(value))

Or if that's too slow, ave:

df$grp_sum <- ave(df$value, df$grp, FUN = sum)

Hadley
